$comment: Mythic Spellbook — move + ability mechanics reference. Every field a move can carry, with its semantics, allowed values, engine notes, and concrete in-game examples. Stable contract — engine reads these field names at runtime.

id.desc: Unique move id (camelCase). Used by learnsets, deck data, save files.

name.desc: Display name shown to the player.

kind.desc: attack = deals damage + can apply status. ability = utility / heal / buff / debuff (no base damage roll). movement = repositioning move (teleport / grappling hook).

type.desc: physical reads attacker.atk vs defender.def; magic reads attacker.mag vs defender.res. Spells should pass 'magic' so Immortal-passive lethal-clamps fire correctly.

power.desc: Base damage power before stat math. For ability/heal moves leave at 0 (use healAmount/healPercent instead). For OHKO finishers set power=0 with effect='ohko'.

range.desc: Chebyshev tile range from the attacker. range 0 = self-targeted. range 99 = global (used by teleport).

cost.desc: Energy cost paid at activation. Basic free attacks should be cost 0 + basic:true.

element.desc: Move element ('fire' / 'water' / 'earth' / 'wind' / 'light' / 'shadow' / 'nature' / 'storm' / 'ice' / 'metal' / 'poison' / 'psychic' / 'arcane' / 'void' / 'blood' / 'crystal' / 'corruption' / 'spirit' / 'lava' / 'sound' / 'gravity' / 'neutral'). Drives type-effectiveness, weather bonuses, element wards.

accuracy.desc: % chance to hit. Below 100 the engine rolls a miss check. Status-only abilities use this too.

crit.desc: Bonus crit chance % on top of the global baseline. Set 0 explicitly on OHKO moves to suppress crit.

target.desc: Ability targeting. Attacks use the active selection UI instead.

basic.desc: Marks the free no-cost basic attacks (slash / quickJab / bite). Used by the AI to pick fallback moves when energy is low.

desc.desc: Player-facing description shown in tooltips + the moves admin list.

icon.desc: Optional inline icon override (used by the Fly/Dig/Realm family). Falls back to the element icon when absent.

air.desc: Marks moves whose CASTING posture is airborne (Sky Dive, Storm Wing, Rift Step, Void Lance). Combined with vanish:true and chargeTurns:1.

applyStatus.$comment: Single-status hook. Fires AFTER damage resolution. The id MUST match an entry in STATUS_EFFECTS. Set chance=100 for a guaranteed application.

applyStatuses.$comment: OPTIONAL second array of statuses to apply in addition to applyStatus. Each entry has the same {id, chance, duration} shape. Used when a single move imposes TWO statuses (e.g. Siphon Grasp does Siphoned + Stun).

vanishStrike.$comment: 🪶 Fly / ⛏ Dig / 🌌 Realm — two-turn vanish-and-return strikes. Turn 1: unit goes off-board, untargetable (but its tile stays blocked). Turn 2: returns and strikes the locked target. Built on the charge-move engine — set chargeTurns: 1 AND vanish: true together.

schema.chargeTurns: int (always 1 for the standard vanish family)
schema.vanish: boolean — toggles the untargetable / hidden state during the charge turn
schema.vanishKind: 'fly' | 'dig' | 'realm' — drives the VFX (sprite goes up into the sky / down into the ground / sideways into a rift)
schema.air: boolean — set true only on fly+realm so anti-air interactions read correctly

engineNotes: While vanish is active, ALL targeting checks against the unit return false — no spells, no overwatch, no AoE damage.
The unit's tile stays blocked so opponents can't walk through where it was.
If the original target dies BEFORE the strike lands, the engine retargets to the nearest enemy in range (so the cast doesn't fizzle).
Damage on the return strike uses the move's full power — vanish gives no extra multiplier, just temporary invulnerability.

elementalReactiveShield.$comment: Reactive shields live on ARMOR items (slotType:'armor'), not on moves. When the wearer is HIT by an attack of the matching damage type, the attacker suffers the configured status. Equip via the Loadout screen → Armor slot.

schema.slotType: 'armor' (required to surface in the Loadout armor slot)
schema.stats: { def: int, res: int, spd: int, hp: int } — flat stat block applied while equipped
schema.hpMod: int — extra HP bonus on top of stats.hp
schema.damageReduction: int — % flat reduction on incoming PHYSICAL damage
schema.damageReductionMagic: int — % flat reduction on incoming MAGIC damage
schema.thornsReflect: int — % of physical damage reflected back to the attacker (separate from the Thorns passive)

reactStatus.id: STATUS_EFFECTS id (burn / frostbite / stun / poison / weak / hexed / slow / etc.)
reactStatus.vs: 'physical' | 'magic' | 'any' — gates whether the proc fires on this hit type

searchDeckOnPlay.$comment: Search Deck is an ON-PLAY effect (lives on the card's onPlay block), not a move. When the unit/hero enters play, the OWNER browses their deck for a card and adds it to their hand. Player gets an interactive picker modal; the AI auto-selects the best match for its archetype.

schema.onPlay.searchDeckType: 'any' | 'unit' | 'hero' | 'summon' | 'spell' | 'trap' | 'location' | 'weather' | 'wall' | 'counter' — type filter for the picker. Ignored when searchDeckCardIds is non-empty.
schema.onPlay.searchDeckCardIds: string[] (optional allow-list of card ids) — restricts the picker to ONLY these cards. Overrides searchDeckType. Use for archetype-specific tutoring (e.g. 'pick one of these three combo pieces').

engineNotes: Fires the instant the card hits the field (post weather-summoner, pre Kalon-on-enter).
If the deck doesn't contain any matching card, the effect logs a 'no targets' line and does nothing.
The found card is added to the END of the hand. If the hand is at cap, the search consumes the find anyway (matches the 'tutor + draw at cap = wasted draw' convention from major TCGs).
Multiplayer: the search modal blocks until the player picks; the opponent sees a 'searching deck…' overlay.
AI scoring: picks the highest-energy unit + on-play AOE first, then high-damage spells, then heals when low HP, then defensive walls/traps.

bonusDamageModifiers.$comment: Per-move damage tweaks that fire INSIDE calculateDamage. Each is optional; multiple can stack on the same move. Multipliers are MULTIPLICATIVE with each other (so two +50% sources = ×2.25, not ×2).

bonusIfAllyAdjacent.desc: Extra damage when at least one friendly unit is adjacent to the TARGET. Used by Flanking Strike. Stacks with the Sneak Attack passive.

effect.desc: Special damage mode flags. 'pierce' = ignores 50% of defender DEF/RES. 'drain' = attacker heals 50% of damage dealt. 'aoe' = use with aoeRadius + splashDamagePct. 'ohko' = LANDING zeros target HP — must pair with low accuracy.

aoeRadius.desc: Chebyshev radius for splash. Set with splashDamagePct. Hits ALL units (friend + foe) in radius around the target.

splashDamagePct.desc: Damage multiplier for splash targets. 0.75 = splash hits take 75% of the main hit.

laneDepth.desc: Lane attacks — depth in rows hit in the column directly in front of the attacker. Pair with splashDamagePct.

knockback.desc: Pushes the target AWAY from the attacker by N tiles. Walls / units / map edges stop the push.

pull.desc: Pulls the target TOWARD the attacker by N tiles. Mirror of knockback.

selfDamagePct.desc: Pay N% of CURRENT HP to use the move. Pairs with Belly Drum / Substitute / Self-detonate.

selfDetonate.desc: Move ALWAYS KOs the user. Damage to target = 99% (100% if user is hurt) of user's max HP.

chargeTurns.desc: Two-turn move. Turn 1 charges (visible windup), turn 2 fires. Combine with sunCharge (free fire under ☀ Sun) and/or vanish (untargetable while charging).

sunCharge.desc: Move that has chargeTurns also fires INSTANTLY (no charge turn) while ☀ Sun weather is active.

sunBoost.desc: Heal moves double their healPercent under ☀ Sun.

gainEnergy.desc: Energy refunded to the user on a successful hit. Used by Harvest Soul to repay 1 of its 5 cost on a kill.

weatherBoosts.$comment: Element + weather match-ups already baked into the engine. Triggered automatically — NOT a move flag. Listed here for authoring reference.

typeChartBoosts.$comment: Element vs element multipliers (TYPE_CHART). Listed by STRONG_VS. Engine applies 2.0 / 0.5 / 1.0 automatically based on attacker.element vs defender.elements.
typeChartBoosts.example: fire 2.0 vs nature/wind/ice/metal; water 0.5 vs fire (because fire strong vs water).

paintSurface.$comment: 🌋 Surface-painting moves lay battlefield hazards on tiles. Surfaces persist for `turns` rounds and interact: oil ignites when fire lands on it, water electrifies during storms, etc. Engine reads card.paintSurface on attack resolution.

schema.paintSurface.radius: int — tiles around the target tile that get coated. 0 = single tile, 1 = 3×3, 2 = 5×5.
schema.paintSurface.turns: int — how many turns the surface persists before fading. Most surfaces tick down 1/turn.

engineNotes: Painting is ADDITIVE — painting Oil on a tile that already has Fire ignites the oil immediately.
Water + Storm-element move on the same tile electrifies the entire water patch.
Fire on a Walls or Trees tile burns the structure for 5/turn until destroyed.
Units with the surfaceWalker passive clear the tile they STEP onto (immune + cleanse).
Surfaces don't damage the unit on entry — they tick on the unit's turn START (so a fresh painted tile gives the target one turn to escape).

stageMods.$comment: Pokemon-style stat-stage system. Each stage shifts the unit's effective stat by ~50% (cap +6 / floor -6). Stages PERSIST through the entire match (unlike status effects which expire on duration). Stages decay only when the unit is KO'd / leaves the field. Use stage mods for permanent buffs / debuffs that should outlast a normal status duration.

schema.stageMods: array of { stat: 'atk'|'def'|'mag'|'res'|'spd', delta: int (-2..+2) } — one move can shift multiple stats at once

engineNotes: Stage formula (Pokemon-equivalent): mult = (2 + clamp(stage,-6,6)) / 2 for positives, 2 / (2 - clamp) for negatives.
Cleanse abilities clear ALL non-permanent status BUT do NOT reset stage mods.
Stage mods stack with applyStatus — a move can grant 'strong' (+4 ATK status) AND atk +2 stage simultaneously.
Stages are tracked per-unit in unit.stages = { atk: 0, def: 0, mag: 0, res: 0, spd: 0 }. They never go below -6 or above +6.

healing.$comment: Heal moves use one of two systems: healAmount (flat HP) or healPercent (% of target's maxHp). Cleanse moves also live here. Heal moves are ALWAYS kind:'ability'.

healAmount.desc: Restore this many HP to the target.

healPercent.desc: Restore this % of target's MAX HP (0.5 = half max HP).

cleanse.desc: Removes all non-permanent status effects from the target.

setupMoves.$comment: Field-state-changing moves: traps, weather, location removal, weather removal. Each fires the listed action when activated.

setsTrap.desc: Places a trap card on a tile when the move resolves.

setsWeather.desc: Summons a weather card matching the supplied weatherType.

destroysLocation.desc: Shatters the active Location field card.

clearsTraps.desc: Disarms enemy traps in the given radius.

revealsTraps.desc: Marks every enemy trap face-up for the rest of the match (doesn't disarm).

smashesWalls.desc: Destroys enemy walls in the given radius.

clearsSurfaces.desc: Wipes painted surfaces (oil / fire / water / mud / glass) in radius.

scanReveal.$comment: Reveal moves uncover enemy unit/hero details (type, faction, element, passives, moves, full stats) in the unit-detail modal. Marks persist for the whole match.

scansTarget.desc: Single-target scan via target='enemy'. Example: scanShot.

scansAllEnemies.desc: AoE scan. Pair with scansRadius (0 = whole board, N = Chebyshev radius from caster).

movement.$comment: Movement moves (kind:'movement') reposition the user. teleport=true skips pathing entirely; freeAction=true means the move does NOT consume the turn's move action.

teleport.desc: Warps to any empty tile within range (range:99 = anywhere).

freeAction.desc: Doesn't consume the unit's move action. Combine with cost > 0 for an 'extra step' move.

statusEffects_RefIndex.$comment: Quick lookup table of every status id valid in applyStatus / applyStatuses. Engine reads STATUS_EFFECTS[id] for the actual stat modifiers.

damageDoT.burn: 🔥 +3..5 fire damage per turn (2-3t). Immunities: fire element.
damageDoT.poison: ☠ +2..4 nature damage per turn (3t). Immunities: nature, metal, poison elements.
damageDoT.bleed: 🩸 +2..3 physical damage per turn (2t). Immunities: earth, metal, void, blood, spirit elements.
damageDoT.toxic: ☢ RAMPING — +N×3 damage per turn (dmgMin=3, escalating). Hits 3/6/9/12 across 4 turns.

controlSkip.frozen: ❄ Skips turn (2t); cleanseable by fire moves.
controlSkip.sleep: 💤 Skips turn (3t) with 35% wake chance each turn.
controlSkip.confusion: 💫 50% chance per move to hit a random target (3t).
controlSkip.rage: 😡 Must attack nearest enemy / can only use attack moves. +3 ATK, -2 DEF.
controlSkip.blinded: 🌫 -2 ATK + 40% chance to fumble each action.
controlSkip.spectralHaze: 👻 All attacks the target makes auto-miss for 3 turns. Pure denial.

buffPositive.protected: 🛡 Immune to ALL damage + status (1t cycle).
buffPositive.countering: ⚔ Counter next attack for 80% of own offense.
buffPositive.reraise: ✨ First KO within 5t revives at 50% HP.

debuffNegative.siphoned: 🩸 Drains 3..6 HP per turn → attacker heals (4t).

doomFinish.doom: ⌛ koOnExpire: when timer hits 0, unit dies. Cleanseable. Example: doomMove fires 3-turn doom.

special.happy: 😊 Cannot attack the source unit (3t). Other targets unaffected.
special.followLead: 🪡 Can only move TOWARD the source + cannot attack at all (2t).
special.ambushGuard1: 🎯 Watch stance. First enemy that moves adjacent (1 tile) eats a free reaction strike. Re-cast after firing.
special.ambushGuard3: 🎯 Long watch. Same as above with radius 3.
special.burningRes: 🔥 Risen in flame — +4 ATK/MAG while burning. Used by Phoenix Rebirth allies.
special.vulnerable: 🎯 Multiplies incoming damage. Set by Weak Point Scan etc. (read by computeDamage as damageTakenMult).

buildYourOwnMove_Checklist: If attack: set type (physical/magic), power, applyStatus (optional).
If ability: target ('self', 'ally', 'allAllies', 'enemy', 'allEnemies'), pick effect (heal*, applyStatus, stageMods, setsTrap, setsWeather, clearsWeather, scansTarget, …).
Set element so type-effectiveness + weather bonuses + element-ward immunities all behave naturally.
Cost should match power: 0 cost for basic; 1 for chip; 2 for moderate; 3-5 for finishers.
If chargeTurns > 0, decide if vanish, sunCharge, or air apply.
If the move imposes statuses, validate the id is in STATUS_EFFECTS — otherwise the entry is dropped silently.
Add a player-facing desc — the admin moves list shows this verbatim.
